---
title: "ssoossh service"
description: "Get certificates for unattended jobs, from an enrollment code."
---

<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in client/cmd. Do not edit. -->

Certificates for unattended jobs. A person runs `service enroll` once and approves it in the browser, which produces an enrollment code. The job then runs `service retrieve` with that code, with no browser, for as long as the enrollment lasts.

## Synopsis

```
ssoossh service [command]
```

## Global options

Inherited from [`ssoossh`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/) and its parents.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--config` | string |  | path to an extra config file, merged after the standard locations |
| `--server` | string |  | server address, e.g. https://ssh.example.com; https is assumed when no scheme is given |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | count | `0` | trace what the command is doing, to stderr; repeat for more (-v steps, -vv requests and files, -vvv bodies) |

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ssoossh service enroll`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/service-enroll/) | Enroll a service keypair for unattended certificate issuance. |
| [`ssoossh service retrieve`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/service-retrieve/) | Retrieve a service certificate using a previously issued enrollment code. |
